title: Abrupt pn junction under reverse bias: depletion charge, width and field (analytic)
description:
An abrupt silicon pn junction (N_A = 1e23 1/m^3 for x < x_j, N_D = 2e23 beyond, eps_dc 11.7, n_i 1e16) on a 1 um strip two 2.5 nm cells high; ohmic contacts on the outer 10 nm, anode at 0 V, cathode at V_R (reverse bias). Stationary sweep V_R = 0..8 V.
Analytic (depletion approximation with the majority-carrier Debye-tail correction -2 V_T, which equals the exact Poisson-Boltzmann first integral at the junction up to ~1e-6): E_j = sqrt(2 q N_A N_D (V_bi + V_R - 2 V_T) / (eps (N_A + N_D))), V_bi = V_T (asinh(N_A / 2 n_i) + asinh(N_D / 2 n_i)) = 0.851 V; depleted charge per m of depth Q = eps E_j Ly; depletion widths x_p = eps E_j / (q N_A), x_n = eps E_j / (q N_D), W = x_p + x_n (0.12 um at 0 V, 0.41 um at 8 V).
Derived values tab: Q_dep = integral of the positive space charge (all of it sits on the n side, so Gauss makes it eps times the junction face field: ~1e-3 at V_R = 0 from the 2.5 nm discretisation of the 13 / 9 nm Debye tails, less at higher bias), W_dep = Q_dep (1/N_A + 1/N_D) / (q Ly) (same accuracy) and E_max = max of -E_x against E_j minus q N_A dx / (2 eps), the drop of the cell-centre field (mean of the two faces) next to the junction face (~1e-3).
Sweep tab: Q_dep, W_dep and E_max versus V_R with their dashed square-root-law curves.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, V_R = 8 V): V_profile (two parabolas; the curve steps by V_T at each depletion edge, where the real potential has a Debye tail about 3 L_D wide), E_profile (the triangle) and rho_profile (the box -q N_A / +q N_D, edges rounded over a few Debye lengths). Field tab: V, E_x, space_charge, N, P.

parameters.name: V_R
parameters.description: reverse bias in V: cathode (n side) voltage, anode at 0 V (the sweep runs 0..8 V)

parameters.name: q_e
parameters.description: elementary charge in C

parameters.name: k_B
parameters.description: Boltzmann constant in J/K

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting)

parameters.name: V_T
parameters.description: thermal voltage in V (25.85 mV)

parameters.name: n_i
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: eps_si
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of silicon

parameters.name: eps_s
parameters.description: static permittivity in F/m

parameters.name: N_A
parameters.description: acceptor density of the p side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: N_D
parameters.description: donor density of the n side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (about 5 cells per p-side Debye length)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: strip height (two cells: a 1D problem)

parameters.name: x_j
parameters.description: metallurgical junction (a cell face)

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: width of each ohmic contact at the strip ends

parameters.name: L_Debye_p
parameters.description: Debye length of the p side in m (13 nm)

parameters.name: psi_p
parameters.description: neutral p-side potential -V_T asinh(N_A / 2 n_i) in V (anode at 0 V)

parameters.name: psi_n0
parameters.description: neutral n-side potential at zero bias V_T asinh(N_D / 2 n_i) in V

parameters.name: psi_n
parameters.description: neutral n-side potential under bias in V

parameters.name: V_bi
parameters.description: built-in potential in V (0.851 V)

parameters.name: E_j
parameters.description: field magnitude at the junction in V/m

parameters.name: x_dep_p
parameters.description: depletion width on the p side in m

parameters.name: x_dep_n
parameters.description: depletion width on the n side in m

parameters.name: W_ref
parameters.description: analytic total depletion width in m

parameters.name: Q_ref
parameters.description: analytic depleted charge of one side in C per m of depth

parameters.name: E_cell_ref
parameters.description: largest cell-centre field magnitude: the p-side cell next to the junction averages E_j and E_j - q N_A dx / eps

analytic_curves.name: V_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < x_j - x_dep_p, psi_p, where(x < x_j, psi_p + V_T + q_e*N_A*(x - x_j + x_dep_p)**2/(2*eps_s), where(x < x_j + x_dep_n, psi_n - V_T - q_e*N_D*(x_j + x_dep_n - x)**2/(2*eps_s), psi_n)))

analytic_curves.name: E_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where((x > x_j - x_dep_p)*(x < x_j), -q_e*N_A*(x - x_j + x_dep_p)/eps_s, where((x >= x_j)*(x < x_j + x_dep_n), -q_e*N_D*(x_j + x_dep_n - x)/eps_s, 0))

analytic_curves.name: rho_profile
analytic_curves.expression: where((x > x_j - x_dep_p)*(x < x_j), -q_e*N_A, where((x >= x_j)*(x < x_j + x_dep_n), q_e*N_D, 0))
